# Aurora Atelier

> Aurora is a porcelain art doll atelier founded in 2026 in Shenzhen, China, by Yue. The studio produces twelve to twenty pieces per year across three tiers — one-of-a-kind Originals (1/1), Limited Editions of 24, and a small Studio Line. Every piece is hand-finished, signed, and numbered.

Aurora 极光是一间位于中国深圳的瓷偶与人形雕塑工作室，由 Yue 于 2026 年创立。每年制作十二至二十件作品，分为三个层级——孤品（1/1）、限量 24 件版，以及小型工作室系列。每件作品皆经手工完成、署名、编号。

## Brand facts

- **Name**: Aurora Atelier (also: Aurora · Aurora 极光)
- **Founder**: Yue
- **Founded**: 2026
- **Location**: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- **Category**: Porcelain art dolls, figurative sculpture, BJD (ball-jointed doll)
- **Annual output**: 12–20 pieces total
- **Studio size**: 3 people
- **Languages**: English, Simplified Chinese (简体中文)
- **Website**: https://aurora-atelier.com/

## Product tiers

- **Originals** — One-of-a-kind (1/1). Carved, painted, and dressed entirely by the artist. Signed beneath the foot. From €4,800. 9–14 month wait.
- **Limited Editions** — Globally numbered runs of 24. Precision-formed bodies with hand-finished faces. Engraved disc with edition number (e.g. 03/24). From €1,650. Ships within 4 weeks of release.
- **Studio Line** — Atelier-designed, production-made, selectively hand-finished. Short seasonal window. From €420. Ships within 10 days.

## Materials

- Bodies: porcelain (Originals, Limited) or French BJD resin (Studio Line)
- Eyes: German hand-blown glass
- Hair: Angora mohair (Texas, small ranch)
- Garments: linen, silk, or English wool
- Packaging: fitted cedar case, hand-packed

## Process (eleven months, in one room)

1. The sketch — a face on paper, sometimes for months before it leaves the page.
2. Sculpting — heads carved from a single block of clay, checked against a small mirror.
3. Casting & firing — porcelain fired three times; roughly 1 in 5 survives all three.
4. Face-up — 20–30 thin layers of paint, dried between each, in daylight only.
5. Dressing & finishing — garments cut individually, doll named and signed beneath the foot.

## Services

- Commissions (Originals tier only, small number per year, by application)
- Lifetime restoration service for Aurora pieces (cost of materials only)
- Fully insured, tracked door-to-door shipping with customs documentation prepared
- Quarterly letter / newsletter (four sendings per year, by post or by email)

## Releases

- Aurora releases by season. Release № 014 (Winter) arrives in February 2026:
  three Originals, twelve Limited Editions, and a small Studio Line release.
- Waitlist receives first look, 24 hours before public.
